notes: Fixed stale FEHA item descriptions that survived outside the current curated folders after the 0.11.48 unified-sheet pass.

The loader now performs a final description-only sweep across world and actor-owned items. Old FEHA weapon, melee, unique, armor, grenade, consumable, and Quickhack wrappers are rewritten with the matching canonical unified card.
The stale-card sweep intentionally changes descriptions only; it does not move folders, alter stats, inventory, ownership, prices, or combat state.
Canonical firearm migration now also recognizes old FEHA gun wrappers outside Do these, including legacy FINAL GUN / REVIEW STATUS / GM REVIEW NOTES cards such as stale Razor Choir copies.
